image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a white Apple iPod Classic resting on top of its original packaging box. The iPod features a white front face with a color LCD screen at the top displaying a music interface (album art and track list) and a circular click wheel below. The casing has rounded corners and a visible metallic edge. To the right, part of the white product box is visible with printed text and graphics.
